text:
maria-ops: FYI—eu-west1 embeddings started spiking 503s at ~08:20 UTC. Trend aligns with kv-cache microtweak from last rollout. Suggest a hotfix revert and quick validation. Need expedited approval to push in next 20m. @sanjay can you prepare?

deploybot: Detected recent deploy 2026-03-21T08:05Z by sanjay. Canary health failing: canary-2 error-rate 1.9%. Recommended actions: rollback to stable or push hotfix. Slots available for expedited deploy: 10m, 30m. Use `/deploy hotfix` to proceed.

sanjay: I have a revert ready (revert f2b7d3 of kv-cache tweak). Will build v1.12.3-rc-hotfix. Question: do we want to run a normal canary (5%) or accelerated (1% -> 50%)?

kelly: Given customer impact, I prefer 1% quick canary then 50% after 3m checks. Approve expedited deploy. Jordan, need on-call signoff.

jordan-sre: On-call OK. Go/no-go metric thresholds: canary error-rate <= 0.2% and no retry storms; p99 within +60ms of baseline for 3 consecutive 1m intervals. If KV-cache miss rate doesn't normalize, we rollback.

olivia-pm: I'll draft a one-line internal release note and prep a customer-facing blurb if this touches production traffic.

maria-ops: Quick actions: pin traffic for premium-tier to stable route before deploy in case of rollback, and create incident ticket #INC-5234. Link to postmortem template: https://wiki.redwood/internal/pmem/embeddings-kv-postmortem.

sanjay: Image built: gcr.io/redwood/embeddings:v1.12.3-rc-hotfix. Ready to run: ```/deploy hotfix embeddings --image=gcr.io/redwood/embeddings:v1.12.3-rc-hotfix --region=eu-west1 --canary=1% --monitor=3m```

kelly: :thumbsup: you have my expedited approval for 1% canary. Do the canary skip only if deploybot flags it necessary.

deploybot: Initiating hotfix canary (1%) in eu-west1. Pipeline id: pb-20260321-99. Running checks: error-rate, p99, kv-cache misses, retry rate. Notifying #eng-releases and #incidents.

jordan-sre: Watching Cloudwatch and SLO dashboards. If canary passes three 1m windows, approve 50% roll.

(3 minutes pass)

deploybot: Canary update: error-rate dropped 1.9% -> 0.05%, p99 latency -10ms, retry-rate normal. KV-cache miss-rate back to baseline. Canary PASS.

jordan-sre: PASS. Approve 50% roll to EU.

sanjay: Rolling to 50%: ```/deploy roll embeddings --pipeline=pb-20260321-99 --target=50% --wait=2m```

deploybot: Roll to 50% underway. Monitoring in 2m slices.

(2 minutes pass)

deploybot: 50% roll complete. Metrics stable, no alerts.

kelly: Approve 100% push for eu-west1. Proceed.

deploybot: Finalizing rollout to 100% in eu-west1. Estimated completion +3m.

(3 minutes pass)

deploybot: Hotfix complete. All eu-west1 traffic on v1.12.3-rc-hotfix. Final metrics: error-rate 0.04%, p99 back to baseline. No active incidents.

maria-ops: Good job. Jordan, monitor for 30m. Olivia, I'll add the short internal release note to the ticket and hand over customer blurb to you.

olivia-pm: Internal note draft: "Hotfix v1.12.3-rc-hotfix deployed to eu-west1 to revert kv-cache change that caused intermittent 503s. Verified healthy. No data loss." I'll post to customers if any follow-ups.

jordan-sre: I'll keep an eye on the metrics for 30m. Rollback plan ready: `/deploy rollback embeddings --to=stable --region=eu-west1` if errors spike.

kelly: Marking as expedited-approved. Assign postmortem owner to sanjay. Thanks everyone. :tada:
